BiblicalUsage: Sânîyʼ is how the Bible says hated. It stands in Deuteronomy 21:15: "…man have two wives, one beloved, and another…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sânîyʼ is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
